name: game-play-route
goal: Generated 2D and 3D games serve the playable /game route while game.json remains importable

evidence: The generated project has a root game.json. Vite resolves extensionless /game to that module before SvelteKit handles its playable route.

Existing CLI scenarios validate generated files without starting Vite. Extend both dimension cases to launch the generated app and require a canvas in its /game HTML; retain the standalone saved-image browser scenario.
